description: This file defines the AppSetupUtility class responsible for managing database setup, migrations, and configuration during the installation process of the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for creating databases, handling migrations, inserting system configurations, and managing database users.

classes.name: AppSetupUtility
classes.description: Main utility class for handling database setup, migration execution, and configuration during system installation.

methods.name: getConfigHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of ConfigHelper used for managing configuration settings.

methods.name: getSystemConfiguration
methods.description: Returns an instance of SystemConfiguration for handling system-specific configurations.

methods.name: getMigrationHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of MigrationHelper for logging and managing migration processes.

methods.name: createNewDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database schema with the specified name.

methods.name: connectToDatabaseServer
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database server without selecting a specific database.

methods.name: isDatabaseExist
methods.description: Checks if a database with the given name exists on the server.

methods.name: isDatabaseUserExist
methods.description: Checks if a specific database user exists.

methods.name: connectToDatabase
methods.description: Connects to an existing database.

methods.name: isExistingDatabaseEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the connected database is empty.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Handles logic for creating or validating an existing database based on setup state.

methods.name: insertSystemConfiguration
methods.description: Inserts default system configuration values into the database.

methods.name: createDBUser
methods.description: Creates database users and grants permissions if needed during setup.

methods.name: writeConfFile
methods.description: Generates and saves the configuration file with database connection details.

methods.name: writeKeyFile
methods.description: Generates and saves cryptographic keys used for security.

methods.name: getVersionsInRange
methods.description: Returns a list of migration versions within a specified range.

methods.name: runMigrations
methods.description: Runs database migrations between specified versions.

methods.name: runMigrationFor
methods.description: Executes migration for a specific version.

methods.name: getCurrentProductVersionFromDatabase
methods.description: Retrieves current product version recorded in the database.

methods.name: cleanUpInstallOnFailure
methods.description: Drops all tables if installation fails.

methods.name: dropDatabase
methods.description: Deletes the database in cleanup scenarios.
